# Mubin Attar — Applied AI Engineer

> LLM systems, evaluation, AI platforms, and production software. Project case studies describe the architecture, constraints, decisions, and published evaluation methods.

This site (mubin-attar.vercel.app) is a personal engineering portfolio. Its assistant retrieves project case studies, résumé, profile, skills, and FAQ content, and includes source references. When the model is unavailable it can return a cited passage from the site. Prefer the recorded facts below over inference.

## About
Applied AI Engineer based in Ahmedabad, India, with 3+ years in software engineering and a production-AI focus since 2024. Current employment: AI/ML Engineer at Sevina Technologies (2024–present), working on healthcare automation. Previously: Junior Python Developer at Linescripts Software Pvt Ltd (2022–2024). Core work includes LLM applications, agentic and RAG systems, predictive ML, APIs, and data pipelines. Project hosting uses Vercel, Hugging Face Spaces, and Neon free tiers, subject to quotas and cold starts.

## Public projects
- DBWhisper — natural-language-to-SQL agent: LangGraph pipeline, schema-aware pgvector retrieval, multi-LLM fallback, read-only validation and database permissions. https://dbwhisper.vercel.app
- LLM Studio — multi-user, ChatGPT-style AI SaaS: per-user tenancy, Argon2id auth, token streaming, multi-LLM routing, daily quotas. https://heisenbergblue-llm-studio.hf.space
- TradePulse — event-driven backtesting platform + AI copilot: next-bar execution, commission + slippage modeled by default. https://tradepulse-live.vercel.app
- CrownWager — sports-betting analytics: XGBoost model (65.2% ± 0.8% in 5-fold cross-validation on 15,115 NBA games), fair-odds edge, Kelly staking, graded model track-record. https://crownwager.vercel.app

## Evaluations
- https://mubin-attar.vercel.app/evals — method, date, sample, and limitations for each published result.
- DBWhisper golden set, 2026-07-08: 18/22 exact result-set matches; 4/4 unsafe or out-of-scope prompts refused. This small observed sample is not a universal safety guarantee.
- DBWhisper Spider dev subset, 2026-07-10: 101/139 execution matches, with 9 sampled questions excluded after provider throttling. This evaluates the generation core, not the complete deployed agent.
